about: Held-out pairs for the claim check, round 3. Written after round 2 had been scored, and after the decision (taken on round 2's result) to ask the model for a second reading only of passages the rules count as supporting a claim. Neither the rules nor that decision has been adjusted to these items, so this file gives the honest estimate for the claim check as the app runs it. A third of the items are passages that look like support and are not (a condition, a plan, a denial, an attempt, a former state), because that is where a second reading matters. Do not tune to these items: if anything changes because of them, write a new round.
